name: test-reboot-warnings
description: Broadcasts fixed countdown warning messages before scheduled server reboots. Each warning has its own cronjob so admins can schedule exact 60/30/15/5/1 minute notices without needing game console commands.

default.message: Server reboot in 60 minutes. Please plan accordingly.
Server reboot in 15 minutes. Please get somewhere safe.
Server reboot in 5 minutes. Log out soon to avoid losing progress.
Server reboot in 1 minute. Log out now.

skipWhenNoPlayersOnline.description: When enabled, warning cronjobs skip without sending if no players are online.

enabled.description: Whether this warning cronjob should send a message when triggered.

message.description: Message to broadcast. Supports {minutesRemaining}, {serverName}, and {playerCount}. Leave blank to skip this warning.

warning60.description: Broadcasts the 60-minute reboot warning. Edit this cron schedule to match your server reboot time.

warning30.description: Broadcasts the 30-minute reboot warning. Edit this cron schedule to match your server reboot time.

warning15.description: Broadcasts the 15-minute reboot warning. Edit this cron schedule to match your server reboot time.

warning5.description: Broadcasts the 5-minute reboot warning. Edit this cron schedule to match your server reboot time.

warning1.description: Broadcasts the 1-minute reboot warning. Edit this cron schedule to match your server reboot time.
